notes: 分层主城：无建筑地形底图 + 7 栋独立建筑 sprite（洋红底抠图），前端分层合成并给每栋建筑加独立动效

items.subject: scripture library pavilion (藏经阁), elegant two-story wooden pavilion, scroll shelves visible through open lattice doors, small stone steps
grand sect main hall (宗门主殿), wide imposing hall with double-eaved roof, red pillars, hanging lanterns, wide white jade staircase
harbor office with a moored sailing junk (远行码头), small wooden dock house with rope coils and cargo crates, one Chinese junk boat with tan sails beside it
seven-story trial pagoda (问道塔), tall slender stone-and-wood pagoda with teal tile eaves on each level, faint glowing runes on the top level
martial training ground (演武场), open-air wooden arena platform with weapon racks, training dummies and banners
artifact forge (炼器炉), squat stone smithy with a large open furnace glowing red-orange, anvil and hammer outside, chimney with smoke
alchemy hall (炼丹房), round-roofed hall with a large golden bronze pill furnace in front emitting green smoke, herb drying racks on the side
